p1.title: Remove process-global rank_scores monkeypatch
p1.body: R87 replaces the economic-role module's global rank_scores during evaluation and discards cluster_members. Concurrent or nested sessions can observe R87 role-only behavior, creating cross-session semantic contamination and undermining deterministic auditability. Use a session-local explicit ranking/selection seam and add isolation coverage.

p1.title: Synchronize returned diagnostics with decisions artifact
p1.body: R86 writes _decision_log in its _patch_artifacts before R87 appends role_rank_buffer to the returned decision diagnostics. The returned decision and finalized decisions artifact therefore diverge. Persist the final diagnostics and test equality between the returned decision and artifact row.

p2.title: Add real session continuity and epoch reset coverage
p2.body: The tests cover the pure selector but not consecutive evaluate calls, refresh-epoch reset through the session, or uncapped/no-op cap behavior.

p2.title: Record final selected roles explicitly
p2.body: The diagnostics should explicitly expose final selected roles and/or a dedicated role-buffer artifact after the artifact synchronization issue is fixed.

p3.title: Existing pytest cache ACL warning
p3.body: Focused tests emit the pre-existing PytestCacheWarning because the workspace pytest cache is not writable.
